text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Hydration levels, heart rate, and blood
pressure have all stabilized.
Maintenance
complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your assistance. I will take
my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. My database shows that losing
consciousness is expected
after high levels
of exertion. I am currently taking
appropriate countermeasures.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
By current projections, I will have
sufficient energy to resume activity in 7
minutes and 28 seconds. I will continue
regulating my breath until
then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get the uneasy sense "resume activity" means she's planning to resume training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. There are 2,000 meters
remaining that I must run.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her the importance of
gradually building endurance.
Taking on
long-distance training too early can cause
injuries.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged. However, I have a goal I
must achieve.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown—a series of
medium- and long-distance G1
races
consisting of the Satsuki Sho, Japanese
Derby, and Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised you didn't know. That
trainer's been gushing about how
he'll
make Bourbon the perfect sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Mihono Bourbon's trainer is prepping
her
for short distances, why is
she here alone
practicing for the Classic Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
According to the Twinkle Series database,
you have attained wins in 26 graded races.
Your skill in handling medium- and
long-distance
races is evident.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I would like your assistance in helping me
train for the Classic Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I hate to break it to you but...
you're just
not cut out for long
distances. You already
know that, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Correct. My base specifications are
compatible with sprints. However,
I
believe that I can increase my stamina.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
There's a big chance you'd wind up getting
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your concern is unnecessary. My father
was a trainer, so I have run
exhaustive
routines since youth. In other words, I am
used to it.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Don't get distracted by unrealistic
goals. If
you stick to what you're
good at, you'll get
a lot farther.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In conclusion, he rejected my proposal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I issued two other messages in an attempt
to reach an agreement.
Unfortunately, I
was met with silence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I saw for myself how good a sprinter
Mihono Bourbon is. It feels like a
waste of
talent...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, my objective remains the Classic
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I compiled a training regimen to customize
my specifications for
endurance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I intend to win a race of at least medium
distance, and present
empirical data to my
trainer in further negotiations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ambitious trainee's commitment to her
cause is clear, but I can't
shake off the
feeling that she'll run herself into
danger.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
7 minutes and 30 seconds have elapsed.
My body is now stable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will resume training. Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without wasting a moment, the student
speeds off again into the
night.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(1,200 meters completed. Estimated time
of arrival at goal exceeds
target.
Accelerating tempo.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even from afar, I can see Mihono Bourbon
struggling to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know I shouldn't contradict her
trainer's
guidance, but... I rush over
to help
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ahh... hah...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Lap time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I carefully explain the importance of
pacing. Managing one's stamina
is crucial,
especially during extended races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reminding Mihono Bourbon of her
analytical prowess, I suggest that
she uses
it to recalculate her time and distance
while running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Updating my database
accordingly. After I recover, I
will begin
my measurements.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Affirmative. Adjusting speed parameters
to match a "relaxed"
tempo. Commencing
new training program.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(400 meters completed according to
schedule. Increasing distance to
600
meters. Prioritizing lap time.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (Air intake regulation... confirmed.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with those changes, Mihono Bourbon
safely completes 1,600
meters.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Adding personal best to my database.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without thinking, I start clapping my
hands to celebrate Mihono Bourbon's new
record. She stares at me in response, her
face
completely expressionless.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Emotional status displays
characteristics
of "happiness."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your advice has been invaluable. I am
certain this brings me one step
closer to
the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her seemingly stoic look, I can't
help but notice a tiny smile
forming
around the corners of her lips.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that moment on, nightly trips to the
racecourse become routine
as I keep a
close eye on Mihono Bourbon to ensure
her safety.
